description: This file defines the Drupal form class 'ModulesUninstallConfirmForm' used for confirming the uninstallation of modules within the Drupal system. It includes methods for building the confirmation form, handling user interactions, and performing the uninstallation process.

classes.name: ModulesUninstallConfirmForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for confirming the uninstallation of selected modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ModulesUninstallConfirmForm class, initializing dependencies and optional install profile.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of the form using the service container.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Returns the text for the confirmation button.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect to if the operation is canceled.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description message for the form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the confirmation form, displaying modules to uninstall and dependencies.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, performing the uninstallation of modules.
